failed_hard_gates.evidence: At native size the stockings have diffuse tonal gradients rather than clearly localized directional textile reflections. At 256x384 they read matte, so the mandatory sheen is ambiguous.
The stocking knit and upper welts prove the textile layer, but neither scale establishes that a lighter shin strip is reflection on that textile rather than ordinary shading.

Native: her anatomical right arm reaches the upper frame corner, while her anatomical left hand contacts the lower side. This is opposite to the frozen left-upper/right-lower assignment despite coherent grips.
